sleep.title: Where to sleep
sleep.text: Holiday Inn Express Chengdu Tianfu Airport Zone is in Wanhui Center in Jianyang, opposite Jianyang South station. The hotel has 316 rooms, with power outlets, USB ports and a shower. The operator’s page lists a shuttle to and from TFU airport. Check-in and check-out are at 14:00; the minimum age for independent check-in is 18.
